data.name: Logix Color Monitor I 12-inch

capabilities.qualification_status: Required design capabilities; analog bandwidth, raster and readable text not yet qualified.

specification.mode_limit: Only advertised legacy raster profiles. The 26.88 kHz 640×400 progressive profile is unsupported; host must reject it.

manufacturing_requirements: Define a purchasable OEM assembly with part numbers and supply agreement, rather than assuming disassembly of retail TVs. Specify RGB insertion/video amplifiers, palette storage and conversion, link receiver, exact raster/bandwidth, chassis and calibration. Count the included HV/deflection once.
Add fixed capability descriptor and bidirectional Control interface; qualify every advertised raster, receiver clock, analog bandwidth, sync and palette behavior before production.
